 Medicare open enrollment: How LIFE Senior Services can help seniors choose the right plan
 Medicare open enrollment is underway, giving seniors an opportunity to review their coverage and make changes for the year ahead.
 October 22, 2026 05:00 PM 2 min read 
 Copy 
 Link copied 
 Email
 Print
 Medicare open enrollment: How LIFE Senior Services can help seniors choose the right plan
 With changes to prescription drug coverage and Medicare plans potentially affecting out-of-pocket costs, experts say it’s important for recipients to review their options each year.
 Eileen Bradshaw with LIFE Senior Services joined News On 6 at Noon to explain why reviewing Medicare coverage matters and how the organization helps seniors navigate the process.
 Q: Why is Medicare open enrollment important for seniors? 
Bradshaw: “Because you only get one crack at the apple, so to speak.”
 Bradshaw said open enrollment is the time of year when Medicare recipients can review their coverage, particularly their Part D prescription drug plans, and make changes.
 Even if a plan worked well this year, coverage could change for the following year.
 “Your pharmacy company could change, your Medicare provider could change what drugs are covered. And they don’t have to tell you that. And you don’t find out until you go to the pharmacy in January. And your drugs cost a lot more.”
 Bradshaw recommends reviewing Medicare coverage annually to avoid unexpected costs.
 Q: How can LIFE Senior Services help with Medicare enrollment? 
LIFE Senior Services offers assistance to Medicare recipients who need help comparing plans and understanding their options.
 “Medicare is complicated, and I don’t think any of us realize that until we’re on it, right?” Bradshaw said.
 The organization helps seniors compare traditional Medicare, Medicare Advantage and prescription drug plans based on their medications and medical needs.
 Bradshaw said LIFE Senior Services does not accept commissions or payments from insurance providers, allowing the organization to offer unbiased guidance.
 Q: Who qualifies for Medicare enrollment assistance? 
Anyone enrolled in Medicare can receive assistance from LIFE Senior Services.
 Appointments are required, and seniors can receive help in person or over the phone.
 Bradshaw said in-person appointments allow staff to sit down with recipients and visually walk through their options, but phone appointments are available for those who have difficulty traveling.
 Q: What other services does LIFE Senior Services offer? 
In addition to Medicare enrollment assistance, LIFE Senior Services provides Medicare education throughout the year, including guidance for people preparing to enroll for the first time.
 Other programs include adult day health services, educational opportunities, volunteer programs and transportation to medical appointments.
 The organization also publishes Vintage Magazine and operates a senior center offering activities such as line dancing, pickleball and mahjong.
 Annual senior center membership dues are $100.
 “So there’s no excuse for anybody to sit at home alone and be bored,” Bradshaw said.
 LIFE Senior Services also offers transportation to medical appointments at little or no cost, depending on the circumstances.
 Q: How can seniors get help? 
Medicare recipients can contact LIFE Senior Services to schedule an appointment for enrollment assistance.
 Bradshaw also encourages family members and neighbors to reach out if they know a senior who may need help.
 “So if you’re a senior or you have seniors in your life, whether it’s a neighbor or family member, before you get too confused about anything, give us a call because there’s a chance we can help.”
